descriptor.scene: DAVID KOBROSKY stands at a long worktable in the center-left of a bright loft, and behind and above him a whole wall rises covered in SEVERAL DOZEN small warm pennants and index cards, each a different color, each carrying a tiny meaningless doodle-mark (never legible text): the ninety startups in his care. FIVE CORAL HOLOGRAPHIC SUB-AGENTS, each WEARING ITS GLOWING WHITE SAILOR CAP, ferry between the wall and his table: one climbing a ladder to pin a card, one carrying a rolled chart, two conferring over a clipboard, one saluting David for a new instruction. On the table the SUPERCHARGED LAPTOP stands OPEN and ANGLED TOWARD THE CAMERA so its GLOWING CORAL SCREEN FACE and keyboard are plainly visible to the viewer; THE BACK OF THE LID IS NOT SHOWN. David is mid-grin, gesturing at the wall with a pencil, clearly the source of all this motion. Keep the table's near lower-right edge simple and calm. David's EYES ARE ON THE WALL OF PENNANTS he is gesturing at, not on the camera: he is looking where he points, face in warm three-quarter view.
descriptor._caption: A few years ago one person could look after a handful of startups. On Anthropic's Applied AI team, David looks after about ninety at once. Ask him how and he grins. Agents, he says. I could not have done this before.
negatives: legible company names or text on the pennants
David overwhelmed or frantic: he is at ease
the back of the laptop lid facing the camera
subject making eye contact with the camera
